title: Senior Product Manager, Integrations
salary: $207K – $244K • Offers Equity • This role is also eligible for medical benefits, 401(k) plan, and other company perk programs.
description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As the Senior Product Manager for Integrations at Vanta, you will be responsible for the ongoing development of integrations across categories, driving direct customer impact through new integrations and expanded capabilities. Vanta currently manages a catalog of over 400 integrations that help customers continuously monitor their compliance and generate the evidence needed to satisfy audit. You’ll drive planning and delivery for a wide range of integration categories and capabilities, such as HRIS/IDP systems, cloud and security platforms, and ticketing systems, building on top of the integrations platform.

 

You’ll be part of Vanta’s Automation group, which owns how customers discover and connect to other platforms through integrations, use that data to power product experiences and tests, drive customers toward compliance-related security outcomes, and ultimately generate the evidence required for audit. You will operate in a few different modes to build your roadmap, balancing direction from other product teams, customer input, and your own prioritization framework to make the right investments. Plus, you will get wide exposure to most parts of Vanta’s products.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Integrations at Vanta:

- Drive integrations roadmap and strategy, determining which new integrations and capabilities are built based on inputs from other product teams, customers, and the broader business environment.

- Pair closely with engineering and design counterparts to prioritize the backlog, plan the roadmap, and make crucial decisions about integration depth, capability, and sequencing.

- Pair with the integration partnership lead to activate the right partners ahead of integration development and manage ongoing enhancements

- Support the ongoing maintenance and improvement of existing integrations.

- Work directly with customers to understand integration needs and document/prioritize their feedback.

- Help tell the story around integrations with collaboration on marketing and field activities, training, and enablement. You’ll also help market our integrations and make them easier to discover and configure.

- Measure and communicate metrics around integration breadth and depth, with an eye toward data availability and solving customer compliance needs.

How to be successful in this role:

- Have 5+ years in a product role around integrations and ecosystem, with an established track record of prioritizing and building impactful integrations. Ideally, you’ve owned an integration catalog or category before.

- Have a good sense of prioritization frameworks that help you effectively focus and sequence integrations work across teams.

- Possess strong collaboration and communication skills, with comfort pairing with other product teams and stakeholders across the business.

- Be technically fluent with comfort in integrations-related technology areas like APIs, authentication, and permissions

- Be a strong planner, with experience coordinating multiple workstreams at once and keeping stakeholders informed and confident.

- Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

- Industry-competitive salary and equity

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

- 16 weeks fully-paid Parental Leave for all new parents

- Health & wellness stipend

- Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Title: Senior Backend Engineer
Role Type: Contract (20 hrs per week)
Location : Remote
Required Skills

• C++

• Python

• Rust

• Golang

• Java

• Javascript

• Devops

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to design, deploy, troubleshoot, secure, scale, and recover production-grade cloud infrastructure. You will develop realistic scenarios involving distributed systems, networking, IAM, queues, durable storage, observability, rolling deployments, and disaster recovery, then build reproducible environments, deterministic validation tests, golden reference solutions, and intentionally defective variants.
Scope of Work

• Design, develop, and implement realistic cloud infrastructure environments to evaluate AI model proficiency in systems design, deployment, and troubleshooting.

• Create detailed and reproducible scenarios involving distributed systems, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), message queues, persistent storage, observability, rolling deployments, and disaster recovery.

• Develop deterministic validation tests and golden reference solutions to ensure the reliability and accuracy of reinforcement learning environments.

• Produce intentionally defective variants and failure scenarios to rigorously test AI model responses and recovery strategies.

• Document the architecture, edge cases, and operational flows for all developed environments, ensuring clarity and reproducibility for future use.

• Collaborate with technical leads and project participants to iteratively refine environment specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Apply DevOps and infrastructure automation practices to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions for cloud-based systems evaluation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Proven expertise with backend programming languages, such as C++, Python, Rust, GoLang, JAVA, or JavaScript.

• Strong practical experience with DevOps, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools.

• Demonstrated ability to architect, scale, and secure distributed systems in production-grade environments.

• Deep understanding of networking, IAM, queues, durable storage, and disaster recovery concepts.

Process:

• Apply to the role, filling out the screening questions

• Complete AI interview (aprox. 30 minutes), reviewed by recruiters

• Hiring Manager review

Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based ; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of 20-hour task per week.
Start Timeline & Availability
We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24-48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: SAP Cloud Application Developer
description:
SAP Cloud Application Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Cloud Application Developer
Location : 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type:  Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range : $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required:  6+ years

Sponsorship : U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) Developer to design, build, and operate extensions, side-by-side applications, and integration scenarios on SAP’s Business Technology Platform. In this role you will leverage BTP services across application development, integration, data and analytics, and AI to deliver clean-core extensions of SAP S/4HANA and other SAP applications. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on experience with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP), SAP Fiori/UI5, BTP services, and CI/CD tooling with a clear understanding of clean-core principles, multi-tenant SaaS design, and SAP integration best practices.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and develop side-by-side extensions and standalone applications on SAP BTP using the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) in Node.js and/or Java.

• Build modern, responsive UI applications using SAP Fiori, SAPUI5, and the SAP Fiori elements framework.

• Develop and consume OData v2/v4 services that integrate cleanly with SAP backend systems and third-party APIs.

• Implement authentication and authorization patterns using XSUAA, SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS), and SAP Identity Provisioning Service (IPS).

• Deploy and operate applications on SAP BTP Cloud Foundry and Kyma runtimes, with appropriate scaling, monitoring, and observability.

• Leverage BTP services across application development, integration, workflow, business rules, and data management.

• Build and operate event-driven extensions using SAP Event Mesh and SAP Advanced Event Mesh.

• Implement BTP-based AI and machine-learning use cases using SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, and integration with hyperscaler AI services.

• Adhere strictly to SAP clean-core principles, minimizing modifications to standard S/4HANA and isolating custom logic in BTP.

• Configure and operate CI/CD pipelines using SAP Continuous Integration & Delivery service, Project Piper, or external tooling such as GitHub Actions.

• Support multi-tenant SaaS application design, including subscription management, tenant onboarding, and data isolation.

• Collaborate closely with functional consultants, enterprise architects, and the integration team to align BTP extensions with broader SAP architecture.

• Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, with structured incident response and performance tuning.

• Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures - so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of SAP development experience, with significant hands-on work on SAP BTP.

• Strong experience with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) in Node.js and/or Java.

• Hands-on experience with SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 development.

• Solid experience with OData v2/v4 service design and consumption.

• Experience with BTP runtimes (Cloud Foundry and/or Kyma) and BTP services.

• Working knowledge of XSUAA, SAP IAS, and SAP IPS.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pat

Sales Job Details

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword - it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce 's core values at the heart of it all.

Now part of Salesforce , Apromore provides organizations with an "Intelligent Process Twin" to gain complete operational transparency. As enterprises rush to scale AI, Apromore bridges the gap between process perception and reality, acting as the critical backbone that enables organizations to systematically discover, de-risk, deploy, and govern Agentic AI automation across the enterprise.

This role is remote, or hybrid for candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices in St. George or Lehi, UT.

Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, the Web Operations Manager is the operational engine of Vasion 's web team - the person who turns business requests into shipped pages and the person who keeps the team's delivery rhythm on track.

This role owns Vasion 's CMS day to day: building and editing pages and landing pages using existing components and templates, and knowing when a request can be handled directly versus when it needs to be scoped and handed to a developer or designer. This role also runs the team's operating cadence - standups, sprint planning, prioritization, and retros - and is the first stop for any stakeholder across Marketing who needs something from the web team. A big part of the job is translating a business ask ("we need a new campaign page," "this section needs to change") into a clear, actionable requirement someone can actually execute against, then following it through to done. • Handle redirect management, URL governance, and the ongoing consolidation of Vasion 's multi-brand web footprint

• Run web team standups, sprint planning, prioritization meetings, and retros

• Serve as the first point of contact for any stakeholder engaging the web team - triage inbound requests and turn them into scoped roadmap items

• Coordinate QA, cross-browser testing, regression testing, and releases with the development team

• Support localization and multi-region site execution in partnership with content and regional marketing teams

Search & Conversion Execution

• Implement technical SEO and AEO/GEO content structuring on pages, based on strategy and priorities set by leadership

• Build, QA, and ship CRO tests defined in partnership with leadership

• Surface technical feasibility and constraints back to leadership to help

title: Embedded Control Engineer

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology - Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion - Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

- Move fast and build what matters - Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

- Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

- Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

- Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

- You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

- You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

- You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

Pharmacies are being asked to do more with fewer resources. Prescription volumes are growing, margins are tightening, and talented pharmacy teams spend too much of their day on repetitive operational work.
We're changing that.
TJM Labs builds AI-powered automation designed specifically for pharmacy. Our technology works within the systems pharmacies already use to automate repetitive workflows and create more capacity for pharmacists and pharmacy technicians to focus on the work that actually requires them.
We're growing quickly, and successful implementation is one of the most important parts of delivering on that promise.
That's where you come in.
About the Role
We're looking for an Implementation Lead to own the day-to-day execution of customer implementations from discovery through go-live and transition to ongoing support.
This is a hands-on role at the intersection of pharmacy operations, project management, customer communication, and technology.
You'll work in close partnership with a Customer Success Manager (CSM). The CSM owns the overall customer relationship, strategic alignment, and escalations. You own getting the implementation done.
During implementation, you'll be the hub of the project. You'll coordinate customer and internal stakeholders, document how the pharmacy operates today, translate those workflows into clear requirements, maintain the implementation plan, manage communication and action items, own internal QA, and drive the project toward a successful go-live.
You'll also own one of the most important safeguards in our implementation process: making sure what the pharmacy does, what we've documented, what we've asked our technical teams to build, and what we ultimately deliver all remain in sync.
This isn't a role where you'll simply maintain a project plan and schedule meetings.
You'll ask questions. You'll uncover exceptions. You'll document details. You'll chase down decisions. You'll test what we've built. You'll notice when something doesn't line up. You'll keep people accountable for commitments. And when a project starts drifting, you'll help get it back on course.
You don't need to be an engineer or an AI expert.
You do need to understand pharmacy operations and pharmacy management systems, be curious about technology, communicate exceptionally well, and be very good at turning complexity into clarity.
What You'll Own
1. Day-to-Day Implementation Execution
Once a customer enters implementation, you'll own the day-to-day work required to get them live.

• Establish and maintain the implementation plan, milestones, dependencies, and target go-live date.

• Lead implementation meetings, discovery sessions, and working sessions.

• Coordinate activities across the pharmacy, TJM technical teams, the CSM, and other internal stakeholders.

• Track decisions, action items, customer deliverables, risks, dependencies, and outstanding requirements.

• Follow up consistently to keep projects moving.

• Identify risks and blockers early and drive them toward resolution.

• Manage implementation changes and understand their impact on scope, requirements, and timelines.

• Keep projects on schedule and surface concerns before they become surprises.

• Coordinate go-live activities and the transition into ongoing support.

At any point in the project, you should be able to answer: What needs to happen next to get this customer live?
2. Pharmacy Process Discovery & Documentation
Before we can automate a pharmacy workflow, we need to understand exactly how that workflow operates today.
You'll own creating and maintaining clear, accurate, and highly standardized documentation of each customer's current-state pharmacy processes before TJM automation is introduced.

• Lead structured workflow discovery with pharmacy stakeholders.

• Understand how work moves through the pharmacy today - including people, pharmacy management systems, other te

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Reliability Engineer to own reliability engineering for advanced IT hardware, from printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) through compute and networking trays, systems, and fully integrated racks. title: Software Test Engineer
description:
Position Overview:
The Software Test Engineer (Mid-Level) is responsible for the overall quality of the Simr Platform, a web application that lets engineers run and manage their simulation workflows in the cloud. The platform has two main areas: the HPC side, where users run batch jobs and work in interactive sessions on HPC clusters, and the data side, where simulation results are ingested, processed, stored and made available for search, analysis and reporting through DataStudio, APIs and Jupyter notebooks.
While the role covers the platform as a whole, its main focus is the data side. The engineer is expected to understand the data workflows in depth, from simulation output files to queryable tables and reports, and to own their test planning, manual and automated testing, and data validation. Working closely with backend, data and frontend engineers, the engineer catches issues early and makes sure data features are released with confidence. The ideal candidate works independently on medium-complexity tasks, is comfortable with SQL and Python, and enjoys understanding how data moves through a modern, cloud-based system.
Responsibilities:

• Plan, design and execute test cases for the Simr Platform, with a focus on data ingestion, processing, storage and reporting features.

• Validate data end to end, from source files to what users see in the UI, APIs and reports, checking accuracy, completeness and consistency.

• Test core HPC workflows of the platform, such as batch job submission and interactive sessions, as part of regression and release testing.

• Use SQL and scripting to verify data and back-end behavior independently.

• Test REST APIs and asynchronous/background processes, including error handling, retries and permissions.

• Develop and maintain automated tests and integrate them into CI pipelines for regression and release testing.

• Conduct performance tests for data-heavy scenarios and report the results.

• Perform regression and release testing across different environments.

• Investigate issues using logs, report bugs in JIRA with clear reproduction steps, and verify fixes.

• Take part in requirement reviews and help define acceptance criteria.

• Maintain test documentation (test plans, test cases, checklists, reports) and suggest process improvements.

• Support junior QA engineers when needed.

Skills & Qualifications:
Must Have

• Solid knowledge of software testing methodologies, test planning and test case design.

• Good SQL skills for data validation.

• Experience testing REST APIs (e.g., Postman or similar tools).

• Programming experience in Python, Java or JavaScript for test automation (Python preferred).

• Experience with test automation and running tests in CI pipelines.

• Familiarity with Linux, version control (Git) and issue tracking tools (JIRA).

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with data pipelines, databases or big data tools (e.g., Airflow, Trino, Spark).

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

• UI test automation experience (Playwright, Selenium or similar).

• Familiarity with Python data tools such as pandas or Jupyter.

• Interest in engineering simulation software such as ABAQUS, ANSYS or

• COMSOL, and familiarity with High Performance Computing (HPC).

• ISTQB or other relevant certifications.

We are looking for an Principal Software Development Engineer (Layer 7 Security & Proxy) to join our team. • Define and evolve ZIA proxy architecture

• Partner with Product Management and engineering on solution design, trade-offs, and end-to-end delivery of core ZIA functionality

• Establish reference architectures and design patterns for ZIA components and integrations

• Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural governance across virtual and product teams

• You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path as you walk it and viewing dynamic environments as the raw material to create something meaningful.

• You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external users while anchoring your decisions in solving real-world problems.

• You are driven by innovation, bringing deep curiosity to complex technical challenges and constantly seeking better, more secure, and scalable solutions.

• You think at scale, connecting your daily work to the larger mission to build solutions that support a high-growth, global organization.

• You lead with integrity by holding yourself and others to high standards of accountability and building trust through consistent, transparent action.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 12 + years of experience of total experience and proven experience in designing and implementing networking security software and public clouds infrastructure

• Deep understanding of Proxies, HTTP/2, QUIC, TCP/IP, TLS/DTLS and SSL proxies

• Proficient in C language

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Strategic customers arrive with multi-entity structures, legacy ERPs, in-flight finance transformations, procurement and treasury requirements, and executive sponsors who expect a named technical leader in the room. Your team is the last line of technical escalation for these accounts - there is no tier above you.

This role suits an experienced leader who can hold two things at once: the operating rigor to run a delivery function at scale, and the technical credibility to sit across from a Controller or VP of Finance and design the solution live.

The goal of the project is to build a dataset of 200 000 images focused on:

• hardware design

• digital system diagrams

Each data record consists of:

• 1 diagram image

• 1 associated technical artifact

The dataset is split 50/50 across the following two variants:
Variant 1

• Diagram image + associated HDL code

• Primary languages:

• Verilog

• SystemVerilog

• Supported standards:

• IEEE 1364

• IEEE 1364-2001 Rev. C

• IEEE 1800-2009

• IEEE 1800-2023

• VHDL is permitted for up to 10% of the Variant 1 volume (optional)

Variant 2

• Diagram image + English technical description accurately explaining the diagram
Diagram Categories (3-way split)
A balanced distribution is required across:

• Circuit diagrams

• Timing diagrams (waveforms)

• State diagrams (finite state machines)

Target distribution must remain within ±3% tolerance per category.
Technical Requirements

• At least 60% gate-level diagrams

• Simple diagrams must not exceed 30% of the dataset

• Both gate-level and block-level diagrams are acceptable within these limits

• Technical coverage includes:

• memory chips

• processors

• digital and logical circuits

• Industry-standard references (e.g. AMBA AXI) may be used to ensure technical realism

title: Pre-Sales Lead

Job Title: Presales Lead - Retail

Location: Tokyo, Japan

Kaluza reimagines energy to bring net-zero within everyone’s reach. Our intelligent Platform enables energy utilities to unlock the full value of a radically changing energy system and propel us to a future where renewable energy is sustainable, affordable and accessible for all.

From automating and simplifying core operations including billing to create a lower-cost, higher-engagement experience, to optimising energy usage across smart devices in the home, we turn tough challenges into win-win-win outcomes for customers, suppliers and the energy system.

Kaluza is currently in an exciting growth phase, undergoing the next phase of our international expansion in Japan to further reinforce our capabilities as a globally distributed energy platform.

We're in the early days of building our team and so in-office presence to us is important - working really closely with our clients to forge a strong working relationship. Our team currently works from our office in Tokyo (Marunouchi Park Building) 3+ days per week..

Our goal is to build a self-sufficient and empowered team here on the ground in Japan. We’re well on our way, but until we get there we still have some reliances on our UK team. Being comfortable working flexibly for a portion of your working week to cover time zones is required.

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working?

You'll be joining Kaluza’s Client Solutions function which is responsible for all pre-sales activity with prospective clients. The team is responsible for understanding the needs of prospective clients and designing solutions using the Kaluza suite of products to help them achieve their strategic goals. Activities the team undertake include delivering product deep dives and demos, running solutions workshops and writing up proposals. You will be the first permanent member of the Client Solutions team in Japan, and will be supported by a global team headquartered in the UK, as well as the Japan Country Manager.

What will I be doing?

 

Client-facing

As Presales Lead for Kaluza’s Retail platform in Japan, you will be responsible for understanding the needs of prospective clients and designing solutions to help them achieve their business goals. You will report jointly to the Client Solutions team in the UK and the Country Manager in Japan, playing a direct role in sales to Kaluza’s prospective clients. The Presales Lead will be an expert on Kaluza’s retail platform from a client or user perspective and champion a consultative approach to helping clients understand the advantages of using it. You will lead needs-based discovery and scoping workshops including preparation and delivery of demos to help clients understand the value we deliver.

Partner-facing

The Presales Lead will work with Kaluza’s Japan-based platform ecosystem partners to train them, and assess their ability to provide the supplementary services required by Kaluza and its clients.

Product-facing

As Presales Lead, you will build a close relationship with Kaluza’s product teams, continuously funnelling feedback to inform short term and long term product roadmaps. You need to develop a detailed understanding of Kaluza’s complex product suite, as well as the typical solutions available on the market. You will also develop a good understanding of the business challenges facing retailers and will be able to bridge the gap between technology and its commercial impact, clearly illustrating benefits for the client that our flexible microservices-based platform can bring.

Example Activities

- Supporting tender responses

- Leading product demonstrations and demos

- Supporting sales pitches to new clients

- Working with existing and prospective clients to understand their current technology solutions

- Architecting client-specific Kaluza-based solutions and demonstrating the commercial outcomes these will deliver for clients

- Leading scoping and discovery workshops wit

title: Staff Product Manager (vMetal)
description:
As a Staff Product Manager for vMetal at vCluster Labs , you’ll help own the systems that discover, provision, configure, and manage physical hardware, turning racks of bare metal into a programmable platform for AI Cloud operators and hyperscalers to build tenant clusters on top of. You’ll work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership on the tradeoffs that shape where vMetal goes next.
As a Staff Product Manager, your role will include:

• Infrastructure Direction: Align on business priorities and technical direction for vMetal across compute and networking, and translate that into specs engineering can execute against..

• Networking: Own vMetal’s networking layer. Define how vMetal provisions and isolates tenant networks across InfiniBand and high-speed Ethernet fabrics, from tenant VPCs to rail-optimized GPU fabrics, and how it works with fabric controllers and NVIDIA’s networking tools.

• Product Leadership Partnership: Work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership to shape the direction of vMetal.

• Hands-on Validation: Run alpha and beta builds yourself, including against real bare metal hardware and network fabrics where possible. Catch integration issues before customers do.

• Customer Intelligence: Engage directly with platform and network engineers at AI Cloud operators and hyperscalers running bare metal at scale, and turn what breaks in their environments into product behavior.

• Market Positioning: Track the bare metal, GPU infrastructure, and data center networking ecosystem. Sharpen the narrative for technical buyers and bridge engineering, sales, and marketing so what we ship matches how we sell and support it.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

• Experience: 5+ years experience in cloud infrastructure, data center networking, bare metal, or GPU/HPC platforms. We’re open to a range of backgrounds for this role, not just traditional product management, including networking and hardware vendors.

• Networking Fluency: You understand InfiniBand, VLAN, VXLAN and EVPN, and BGP, and the NVIDIA networking stack (Spectrum and Quantum switches, UFM, Cumulus Linux, NVUE), well enough to make informed product tradeoffs.

• Infrastructure Fluency: You understand bare metal provisioning, out-of-band server management (Redfish, IPMI), and PXE boot well enough to make informed product tradeoffs.

• Customer-Facing Infra Experience: You’ve sat across from platform engineers, network engineers, and architects, and you’re comfortable in that conversation.

Bonus points for:

• AI Networking Depth: Familiarity with fabrics tuned for GPU training or inference workloads, such as RoCEv2, rail-optimized topologies, or Spectrum-X.

• Kubernetes-as-a-Service: Built a KaaS offering at a cloud provider, vendor, or large internal platform team.

• Startup Growth: Adaptable to startup pace and change.

title: Global Immigration and Mobility Manager
description:
Global Immigration and Mobility Manager

Location: Edinburgh or Glasgow (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Corporate Services | Department: Global HR Operations | Type: Permanent

Shape global immigration excellence. Support our people. Ensure compliance across borders.

The Role

At Capco, we are looking for a Global Immigration and Mobility Manager to oversee and enhance our processes across the countries in which we operate.

You will play a key role in ensuring immigration compliance, managing UK visa sponsorship requirements and coordinating international immigration activities. You will provide specialist guidance, oversee immigration and mobility service relationships and partners and maintain effective compliance controls, working closely with our wider HR teams and business stakeholders, to navigate complex immigration challenges, identify opportunities for process improvement and ensure our practices remain aligned with evolving legislation.

What You’ll Do

• Manage UK sponsorship and coordinate international immigration: Oversee UK visa sponsorship activities, including applications, extensions, CoS, visa expiry monitoring, sponsor reporting obligations. Coordinate immigration and visa requests across EMEA and APAC with internal stakeholders and the Group’s global mobility function.

• Maintain visa compliance and operational controls: Maintain UK sponsorship records, documentation and compliance obligations. Coordinate with local HR teams on country-specific immigration documentation requirements, identify risks and support improvements to existing controls.

• Manage Immigration and Mobility Partner relationships: Oversee relationships with the Group’s Global Mobility function and external immigration and tax advisers, leading regular service meetings, monitoring case progress and supporting effective service delivery..

• Provide Specialist Immigration Guidance: Act as a trusted point of contact for immigration matters, including high-priority and sensitive cases. Provide specialist UK sponsorship advice and support immigration assessment and approvals for cross-border working, international transfers, overseas remote working and new business activities, coordinating specialist advice where required..

• Deliver Insights and Continuous Improvement: Monitor regulatory developments, maintain relevant immigration management information and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, processes and service delivery, .

What We’re Looking For

• Immigration Expertise: Demonstrable experience managing immigration processes, with comprehensive knowledge of UK immigration legislation, visa sponsorship, Home office regulations and the Sponsor Management System (SMS).

• Global Immigration and Mobility Knowledge: Understanding of international immigration practices and cross-border mobility arrangements, with the ability to interpret regulatory requirements, support compliant processes across multiple jurisdictions.

• Stakeholder and Partner Management: Experience building effective relationships and collaborating with internal stakeholders and external service providers, including managing complex and sensitive immigration cases.

• Operational and Analytical Skills: Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the  ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate projects, analyse management information to support operational improvements.

• Communication and Problem-Solving: Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgement and the ability to navigate sensitive or time-critical immigration matters with accuracy, discretion and attention to detail.

Bonus Points For

• Experience supporting immigration and mobility activities across Europe, APAC and the United States.

• Experience establishing or improving immigration quality assurance frameworks, compliance controls and audit readiness.

• Familiarity with immigration supplier performance monitoring against SLAs and KPIs.

title: Retention Specialist
description:
Description
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners - people with no prior tech background - through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
We are looking for a Student Retention Specialist to support students in their learning journey and help them stay committed to their educational goals.
This role is responsible for driving student engagement, retention, and overall satisfaction by building meaningful relationships, identifying potential challenges, and providing proactive support. You will work closely with students to help them stay motivated, overcome obstacles, and successfully achieve their educational goals.
What you will do

• Engage with students through retention-focused calls and chats, addressing refund and cancellation requests with empathy and professionalism.

• Identify the underlying reasons behind student dissatisfaction and provide personalized solutions to improve their experience and commitment.

• Manage renewal and recurring payment conversations, proactively reaching out to students before their current term ends to support extensions and continued enrollment.

• Consistently meet or exceed weekly retention (save rate) and renewal performance goals.

• Maintain accurate and detailed records of all student interactions within CRM systems.

• Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and continuous development initiatives to enhance performance and student outcomes.

Requirements

• 1+ years of experience in Retention, Customer Success, Sales, or another customer-facing role.

• Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal, as you'll be supporting English-speaking students.

• Strong empathy, active listening, and relationship-building skills, with a genuine desire to help others succeed.

• Comfortable working in a target-driven environment and meeting performance goals.

• Resilient, adaptable, and able to remain calm and solution-oriented during challenging conversations.

• Experience using CRM platforms to manage customer interactions and maintain accurate records.

What we can offer you

• Clear performance expectations, fast feedback loops, and full ownership of your work and results.

• Join a mission-driven company helping thousands of people transform their careers through education and technology.

• A fast-paced environment built on accountability, ownership, and impact-without unnecessary bureaucracy.

• Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely with a high level of autonomy, trust, and minimal micromanagement.

• Collaborate with talented professionals from diverse backgrounds across tech, ed-tech, and other industries.

• Work with platforms like Notion, Miro, Google Workspace, and other digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.

• Your work will directly contribute to improving student retention, engagement, and long-term success.

Compensation & Schedule

•
Compensation: 1,500 USD fix + performance-based bonus per month.

•
Schedule: Monday to Friday.

•
Working Hours: Approximately 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM CET (8:00 AM - 5:00 PM Colombia time).

description:
About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.

With programs like Future of Medicine , which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers , which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access , visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference

The Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software applications that support clinical research and participant pre-screening operations. This position collaborates with cross-functional product development teams to develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive manual and automated testing strategies, with a strong emphasis on end-to-end test automation using Playwright. The QA Engineer identifies, documents, and helps resolve software defects throughout the development lifecycle, contributing to the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and reliable software solutions that support organizational objectives and enhance the user experience.

How You'll Make An Impact

• Design, build, and maintain automated end-to-end test suites using Playwright across web and API surfaces.

• Perform exploratory and structured manual testing on complex user flows, edge cases, and regression scenarios.

• Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable feedback on every pull request.

• Collaborate closely with engineers and designers during development to shift quality left, writing tests alongside features, not after.

• Triage, reproduce, and document bugs with clear steps and context that accelerate resolution.

• Contribute to and improve QA processes, standards, and tooling across the engineering organization.

• Participate in test planning, sprint ceremonies, and release readiness reviews.

The Expertise Required

• Strong proficiency with Playwright (or a comparable framework like Cypress or Puppeteer) and the ability to write maintainable, reliable tests.

• Solid manual testing instincts: you know when to automate and when hands-on exploration surfaces more value.

• Experience integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar).

• Familiarity with testing APIs alongside UI flows, including REST and GraphQL endpoints.

• Strong communication skills: you can write a clear bug report, explain a test strategy, and advocate for quality with engineers and PMs alike.

• Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and judgment matters.

Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience

• Minimum Education:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience

• Minimum Experience:
• 3+ years of experience in software QA, with meaningful time spent in test automation.

How We Work Together

•
Location : Remote within the United States. This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment.

•
Travel : This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role.

•
Physical demands associated with this position Include : The ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment.

The expected pay range for this role is $80,000 - $110,000 USD per year for full time
